title: Rust 1.83+ (Axum + Tokio + SQLx)
testFramework: cargo test + integration tests in tests/
summary: Rust 1.83+ (2021 Edition), Axum 0.8+, Tokio, SQLx, thiserror, anyhow
rules: Domain errors must use thiserror enums. Application binaries use anyhow::Result.
Negative Constraint: NEVER use .unwrap() or .expect() in production paths; propagate errors via ?.
Avoid unnecessary allocations and .clone(). Prefer references (&str, &[T]). Disallow unsafe.
Tokio async safety: Never hold std::sync::Mutex across .await points; use tokio::sync::Mutex or channels.
All code must pass cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings with zero warnings.
